name: Toujou Ichika
source: A girl who thinks that sex should only be performed between a man and a woman in private who are married. She thinks Noa had sex with Toma in the classroom to fulfill Noa's own immoral desire for exhibitionism. She is completely against the idea of a sex card and sex in public is outrageous. However Toma takes advantage of the fact that she can't say no to have sex with her in the open.
